description: For a complete consistent Henkin set \(S\), a scoped formula evaluated at classes of closed-term representatives holds if and only if its closed instance belongs to \(S\). In particular, \(M_S\models\theta\) if and only if \(\theta\in S\) for every sentence \(\theta\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.truth_lemma.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {S : Set (L.Formula ℕ)}
  (hS : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent S)
  (hC : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.Complete S)
  (hH : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.Henkin S) {n : ℕ} (φ : L.BoundedFormula ℕ n)
  (ts : Fin n → L.Term ℕ) :
  (φ.Realize (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.nameValue S hS hC) fun i => ⟦ts i⟧) ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.closeSlots φ ts ∈ S
